doc.body: Admit a standalone OpenAPI 3.x JSON/YAML document as exact UTF-8 bytes; the public maximum is 268435456 bytes (256 MiB), with a lower per-instance limit configured by OMNIWRAP_SOURCE_MAX_BYTES (32 MiB by default). No Content-Encoding, multipart, base64 carrier decoding, archive, URL, Git, bundle or external reference fetching. Count actual streamed bytes, not characters or a decoded representation; Content-Length is advisory. Above the effective instance limit, reject with 413 before admission. The isolated engine then normalizes and records pending to valid/invalid. This 202 is byte admission only.

doc.body: Default application/json gives durable replay in ascending sequence, strictly after cursor. Accept:text/event-stream opens a bounded authorized stream; each preview_event has id:<opaque cursor> and one JSON data line matching PreviewEvent, max16384 UTF-8 frame bytes. Comment heartbeat every15s has no cursor. Reconnect reauthorizes and replays persisted events, duplicates must be deduplicated by id. A gap/expired cursor is410 before streaming; authorization denial after headers closes immediately without more data. No event may certify a proof by itself.
